fees.source: https://www.jacksonville.gov/departments/parks-and-recreation/jaxparks/oceanfront-parks/huguenot-memorial-park ('All fees listed below include tax: ... RV fee per night: $27.24', i.e. $24.00 plus 13.5%), read 2026-10-20

values.note: City of Jacksonville: online (the city's WebTrac reservation system), by phone (904-255-4255, Monday-Friday 9-5) or in person. Check-in 1:00-9:30 pm, no check-ins after 9:30; check-out noon. RVs at most 30 days in any 45 (tents 14). Cancelling costs one night with tax; one free reschedule if the office is told by 5 pm the day before.

booking.source: https://www.jacksonville.gov/getmedia/acce064d-07b5-442c-8e77-c38b8bd184b6/Huguenot-Rules-Revised-4-21-26_1.pdf (park rules revised 4-21-26: Reservations, Check-In, Cancellations, Camping Limit) + the park page (Online Reservation, phone hours), read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: https://www.jacksonville.gov/getmedia/acce064d-07b5-442c-8e77-c38b8bd184b6/Huguenot-Rules-Revised-4-21-26_1.pdf ('All campsites have electricity 110/30amp/50amp however, they do not have water or sewer') + the park page ('Electric now offered at all campsites but no water or sewer'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Centralized potable water and dump station; showers are code-locked. Only self-contained RVs are permitted. Dumpsters in the campground; generators off 10 pm - 7 am.

facilities.source: https://www.jacksonville.gov/getmedia/acce064d-07b5-442c-8e77-c38b8bd184b6/Huguenot-Rules-Revised-4-21-26_1.pdf ('A centralized potable water and dump station is available', 'Do not give out the shower codes', 'Only self-contained RV's are permitted'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed $24 ($27.24 with tax). Added booking (city system/phone/in person, 30-night RV limit in 45 days, check-in/out and cancellation), 30/50-amp at every site with no water or sewer, potable water, dump, showers. Not stated: campground season (park hours only), site count or lengths.
